EN: Relax. We are with you on this. We killed a bunch of your Enclave on our way here.
ZH: 放松。我们是站在你这边的。来这里的路上我们干掉了一大帮你的英克雷同伙。

EN: A spy! Let's capture him for interrogation.
ZH: 间谍！抓住他审问。

EN: This is not good. My work must remain secret.
ZH: 这可不好。我的工作必须保密。

EN: You really think the Enclave would leave this place be? We punish traitors.
ZH: 你真以为英克雷会放过这地方？我们是要惩处叛徒的。

EN: Let's make the commander proud!
ZH: 让指挥官为我们骄傲！

EN: Protect the Reserves, protect America!
ZH: 守护黄金储备，守护美利坚！

EN: We must be popular: we've got another distress call, this time from a defecting scientist named Wilzig. By now, it's clear none of these are a trap.
ZH: 我们一定很受欢迎：又收到了一个求救信号，这次来自一位名叫威尔齐格的叛逃科学家。事到如今，很明显这些都不是陷阱。

EN: Calls of Despair
ZH: 绝望的呼救

EN: Find Wilzig
ZH: 找到威尔齐格

EN: Survive the fires of Hell
ZH: 在地狱之火中活下来

EN: We're off to answer a new distress call. Definitely not a trap.
ZH: 我们又出发去回应一个新的求救信号。绝对不是陷阱。

EN: They came! I can't believe they fell for it.
ZH: 他们来了！真不敢相信他们上钩了。

EN: IT'S A TRAP!
ZH: 这是陷阱！

EN: I'm Wilzig. And these are my friends.
ZH: 我是威尔齐格。这些是我的朋友。

EN: Worth a try.
ZH: 值得一试。

EN: Almost fooled you!
ZH: 差点就把你们唬住了！

EN: Digits? You mean fingers? In pies? Oh! You tricked us.
ZH: 数字？你是说手指？还是插在苹果派里的？哦！被你诈出来了。

EN: I'm not falling for that one.
ZH: 我可不上这个当。

EN: Finally, we found you and... hey, wait a minute...
ZH: 终于找到你了，而且……嘿，等一下……

EN: Prove it. Tell me the first 20 digits of pi.
ZH: 证明给我看。说出圆周率的前20位。

EN: Please lower your weapons and we can all defect together.
ZH: 请放下武器，我们可以一起叛逃。

EN: Your meddling ends here! You cannot prevail against the Hellfire Elites!
ZH: 你们的干预到此为止！你们不可能战胜地狱火精英！

EN: We're the Heaven Water Super Elite! You lose!
ZH: 我们才是天堂之水超级精英！你们输了！

EN: GOLDAS leads us to the golden realm!
ZH: GOLDAS引领我们迈向黄金国度！

EN: The Gold-Obsessed Leadership Directive and Amassment System does not answer to you.
ZH: 黄金痴迷领导指令与囤积系统（GOLDAS）可不听你的号令。

EN: Who the heck is GOLDAS?
ZH: GOLDAS到底是个什么鬼东西？

EN: Prosperity is prospecting for posterity!
ZH: 繁荣，就是为子孙后代去勘探！

EN: Don't shoot! They caught me sending the signal.
ZH: 别开枪！他们抓到我发信号了。

EN: Yeah, well... I'll be *heading* for your vault soon. You just wait.
ZH: 嗯，是啊……我很快就会*直奔*你们的避难所。你们就等着吧。

EN: No time? I'm pretty sure you cleared up the place. I will show up in time.
ZH: 没时间了？我很确定你们已经把这地方清理干净了。我会准时出现的。

EN: I do have these plans. Take them. I'll sabotage this place, then make travel arrangements.
ZH: 我手上正好有套图纸。拿去吧。我会先在这里搞点破坏，然后再安排行程。

EN: Good thing you didn't lose your head over it!
ZH: 还好你没为此丢掉了脑袋！

EN: No time to chat. Come with us.
ZH: 没时间闲聊了。跟我们走。

EN: Before we leave, any good stuff we can bring with us?
ZH: 走之前，有什么好东西我们能带走的吗？

EN: I truly want to leave. GOLDAS is a horrible leader.
ZH: 我是真心想离开。GOLDAS是个可怕至极的领袖。

EN: Defective Leadership
ZH: 有缺陷的领导

EN: Protect our secret. They can't find out we infiltrate them with pets!
ZH: 守住我们的秘密。绝不能让他们发现，我们是用宠物渗透进去的！

EN: Intel says the Enclave's coming for us with something big, but we're already one step ahead. First stop: a lab running twisted experiments on animals.
ZH: 情报显示英克雷正带着个“大家伙”冲我们而来，但我们已抢先一步。第一站：一座拿动物搞变态实验的实验室。

EN: Pet Distribution System
ZH: 宠物分发系统

EN: Rescue every last fur baby.
ZH: 拯救每一只毛孩子。

EN: Deal with Agent Deathclaw.
ZH: 对付死爪特工。

EN: Shut down the animal experiments.
ZH: 关闭动物实验。

EN: Hey, you here to pick up your Enclave-sanctioned spy pet?
ZH: 嘿，你是来领取英克雷批准的间谍宠物的吗？

EN: Wow. Not only intruders, but too dumb to play along?
ZH: 哇。不只是入侵者，还蠢到不配合演戏？

EN: Don't hold your hands out. I'm not the one giving them out, that's further in.
ZH: 别把手伸出来。发宠物的可不是我，得再往里走。

EN: We need more folks like you to deal with those pesky Vault Dweller gold thieves.
ZH: 我们需要更多像你这样的人，来对付那些烦人的避难所盗金贼。

EN: The what now?
ZH: 什么玩意儿？

EN: Yes, please.
ZH: 好啊，麻烦了。

EN: Certainly. As you can see by my outfit, I do undercover work.
ZH: 当然。看我这身打扮就知道，我是搞卧底工作的。

EN: What... what are those weapons for?
ZH: 那些……那些武器是干什么用的？

EN: I run the virtual reality programming. That's how we train them.
ZH: 我负责虚拟现实程序。我们就是这样训练它们的。

EN: Err... more peeps like me, I guess. Storage units too. And watch out for Agent Deathclaw.
ZH: 呃……还有更多像我这样的人，大概吧。还有几间储藏室。另外小心死爪特工。

EN: You might yet live! What's the plan here? How do you turn pets into spies?
ZH: 你或许还能活命！这里的计划是什么？你们怎么把宠物训练成间谍？

EN: You look ready for a villain monologue, but I'm in a bloody mood.
ZH: 看你的架势是想来段反派长篇独白，但老子今天一身杀气。

EN: What can we expect ahead?
ZH: 前面会有什么等着我们？

EN: You're *them*, aren't you? I knew this day would come.
ZH: 你们是*他们*，对吧？我就知道会有这一天。

EN: The reckoning.
ZH: 清算的时刻到了。

EN: An unattended terminal. Let's check it out.
ZH: 一台没人看管的终端机。我们去看看。

EN: This program says: "Pet Tender"
ZH: 这个程序写着：“宠物相亲探探”

EN: Is that a dating application for pets?
ZH: 这该不会是个宠物相亲软件吧？

EN: Oh! Even better. We can get our own pet right here.
ZH: 哦！那更妙。我们就能在这儿领到一只自己的宠物了。

EN: Only the one though. Maybe we can find more pets further in.
ZH: 不过只有一只。也许往里走还能找到更多宠物。

EN: We must protect our deep-infiltration creature program.
ZH: 我们必须保护我们的深度渗透生物计划。

EN: If not us, then Agent Deathclaw will. Our greatest success. He even talks and everything.
ZH: 就算没有我们，还有死爪特工呢。它是我们最大的成功，它甚至还会说话，还有一堆别的本事。

EN: You don't look like much. Think you can stop me?
ZH: 你看起来不怎么样。你觉得能拦住我吗？

EN: You can't see me. I am stealth incarnate.
ZH: 你看不见我。我是潜行的化身。

EN: No you can't. But just to be sure, let me pluck out your eyes.
ZH: 你不行。不过为了保险起见，让我把你眼睛抠下来。

EN: I smell bad? I need a bath, then. Rain check?
ZH: 我闻起来臭？那我得洗个澡了。改天再约？

EN: What was that? Who's speaking? ... Must've been the wind.
ZH: 那是什么？谁在说话？……一定是风声。

EN: Ahem... I can see you just fine.
ZH: 咳……我看你清清楚楚。

EN: Even if you were invisible - and you're not - your stink gives you away.
ZH: 就算你隐身了——可你并没有——你的臭味也会出卖你。

EN: You can't see me either. We are two phantoms crossing paths in the dark.
ZH: 你也看不见我。我们是两个在黑暗中擦肩而过的幽灵。

EN: Prepare to be slain by shadows.
ZH: 准备死于暗影之手吧。

EN: <Pet VR spy training program: Animal Double-Crossing>
ZH: <宠物VR间谍训练程序：动物双重背叛>

EN: <Participant number critical. Freeing all subjects.> Oh neat! We got them all.
ZH: <参与者数量告急。释放所有受试者。>哦太棒了！我们把它们都救出来了。

EN: <Lord Puffington disconnected. Puffington's friends also disconnected. Current occupancy: 0.>
ZH: <帕夫顿爵士已断线。帕夫顿的朋友们也已断线。当前占用：0。>

EN: <Overflow exception. Releasing all subjects.>
ZH: <溢出异常。释放所有受试者。>

EN: Let's pick the cat. I'm more of a cat person, anyway.
ZH: 我们选那只猫吧。反正我更喜欢猫。

EN: I choose the biggest, meanest dog.
ZH: 我选那只最大最凶的狗。

EN: Gotta get 'em all!
ZH: 全都要收服！

EN: <Current pet occupancy: 3>
ZH: <当前宠物占用：3>

EN: <Choose pet to extract>
ZH: <选择要提取的宠物>

EN: The gold thieves? Here? Sound the alarm!
ZH: 盗金贼？在这儿？拉响警报！

EN: Protect the scientists! Guard Dr. Jackal!
ZH: 保护科学家！护卫杰克尔博士！

EN: Didn't we poison these guys? Apparently, they need a hands-on reminder!
ZH: 我们不是给这些家伙下过毒吗？看来得给他们上点“亲身体验”的课！

EN: We've detected a foreign substance in our power supply. We traced the toxin back to an Enclave research bunker.
ZH: 我们在电力供应中检测到一种外来物质。我们一路追查毒素，追到了一座英克雷研究地堡。

EN: Better Death Through Chemistry
ZH: 化学带来更佳死亡

EN: Poison the poisoners
ZH: 给下毒者下毒

EN: Set back Enclave research by decades
ZH: 让英克雷研究倒退几十年

EN: Assault the Enclave research bunker
ZH: 突袭英克雷研究地堡

EN: More test subjects? Where's your escort?
ZH: 更多受试者？你们的护卫呢？

EN: Girls, let's show these ruffians the power of STEM!
ZH: 姑娘们，让我们给这些痞子见识见识理工科的威力！

EN: Well, we were set to try bio-engineered Radscorpion venom, but the sample's gone. Come back later.
ZH: 唔，我们本来要用生物工程辐射蝎毒液的，但样本不见了。改天再来吧。

EN: Nope. That's Group C under Dr. Jackal. If you're headed that way, can you deliver this?
ZH: 不对。那是杰克尔博士手下的C组。要是你们往那边去，能帮我捎个东西吗？

EN: Our escort's in a puddle of their own blood back there.
ZH: 我们的护卫正躺在后面自己的一滩血里呢。

EN: They're with another group. So, what's the test?
ZH: 他们跟另一组在一起。那，测试是什么？

EN: Are you the ones poisoning our water?
ZH: 是你们在往我们的水里下毒？

EN: A terminal! Time for some Expert hacking.
ZH: 一台终端机！是时候来点专家级黑客操作了。

EN: Spam. Chain mail. "Enlarge your stinger". Nothing of value…
ZH: 垃圾邮件。连锁信。“增大你的毒针”。没什么有价值的东西……

EN: Wait! What's this? <Forced Evolutionary Virus>. Nah, probably worthless as well.
ZH: 等等！这是什么？<强制进化病毒>。切，八成也没啥用。

EN: Ah! There it is: Project Gold Taint! So they put heavy metal in our water supply.
ZH: 啊！在这儿：“黄金污染计划”！原来他们往我们的供水系统里加了重金属。

EN: Clever. Could've passed for natural contamination!
ZH: 真聪明。说不定真能伪装成自然污染！

EN: What are you doing here? Dr. Jackal will hear of this.
ZH: 你们在这儿干什么？杰克尔博士会知道的。

EN: Venom? No. Why would you think that? And since you're here…
ZH: 毒液？才没有。你怎么会这么想？既然你送上门来了……

EN: Preposterous. Time to give you a different kind of lead poisoning.
ZH: 荒谬透顶。是时候让你们尝尝另一种“铅中毒”的滋味了。

EN: Wanna fight with words? Or fight with weapons?
ZH: 想斗嘴？还是想真刀真枪干一场？

EN: So you're dumping venom in our water supply?
ZH: 所以是你们在往我们的水里倒毒液？

EN: You guys suck at naming things.
ZH: 你们这帮家伙取名字的水平真烂。

EN: Is stopping you for good considered a hindrance?
ZH: 把你们永久除掉，算不算妨碍？

EN: Nobody hinders the work of the Venomenon™ research group.
ZH: 谁也不能妨碍毒尼曼™研究组的工作。

EN: You've ruined everything. Just drink your water and die already!
ZH: 你们毁了一切。乖乖喝水然后去死吧！

EN: With this power, call me Mr. Snide!
ZH: 凭这股力量，就叫我刻薄先生吧！

EN: Prepare to die, Dr. Jackall.
ZH: 准备受死吧，杰克尔博士。

EN: I may be a scientist, but I'll show you the power my chemistry genius grants me.
ZH: 我或许是个科学家，但我会让你见识见识我化学天赋赋予我的力量。

EN: Well, well, well. This terminal taps straight into the Enclave's water supply.
ZH: 哎呀呀。这台终端机直接连接着英克雷的主供水管道。

EN: We haven't seen a single bathroom. There is gonna be chaos.
ZH: 我们连一个厕所都没见过。马上要大乱了。

EN: They'll be swimming in babies. That'll keep them busy. No more time for scheming.
ZH: 他们会生一屋子孩子。这下够他们忙的了。再没时间搞阴谋了。

EN: I almost envy all the naps they're about to take.
ZH: 我甚至都有点羡慕他们接下来能睡那么多好觉了。

EN: <Add laxative to water supply>
ZH: <往供水系统里加泻药>

EN: <Add love potion to water supply>
ZH: <往供水系统里加爱情魔药>

EN: <Add sleeping powder to water suply>
ZH: <往供水系统里加安眠粉>

EN: Maybe we give them a taste of their own medicine…
ZH: 也许我们该让他们自食其果，尝尝被下药的滋味……

EN: We are the Fission Bros... brace yourself for irradiation!
ZH: 我们是裂变兄弟……准备好接受辐射吧！

EN: Our spies report the Enclave is breeding abominations to field as soldiers. There's still time to shut them down.
ZH: 我们的间谍报告说，英克雷正在培育怪物作为士兵投入战场。现在阻止他们还来得及。

EN: The Matchmakers
ZH: 变异红娘

EN: Deliver the lovers from their fate
ZH: 让有情人摆脱他们的命运

EN: Have a chat with the Enclave officer
ZH: 和英克雷军官聊一聊

EN: Stop the Enclave's monster-breeding operation.
ZH: 阻止英克雷的怪物培育行动。

EN: Begone. This place is no longer under Enclave control.
ZH: 滚开。这地方已不再受英克雷控制了。

EN: Or maybe you can help. Deeper in this facility, horrors still linger.
ZH: 又或许你能帮上忙。在这设施的更深处，恐怖仍在徘徊。

EN: We were bred as killers, but we chose love. Why force us to fight?
ZH: 我们被培育为杀手，但我们选择了爱。为什么要逼我们战斗？

EN: You don't get it. We refuse to be weapons, no matter the master. Take this as proof.
ZH: 你不明白。无论主人是谁，我们都拒绝成为武器。拿这个当作证明吧。

EN: Looks like we came for nothing then. Our goal was to stop those experiments.
ZH: 看来我们是白跑一趟了。我们的目标是阻止那些实验。

EN: I hear what you're saying, but honestly, we can't take that risk.
ZH: 我明白你的意思，但老实说，我们不能冒这个险。

EN: Join us. We also fight the Enclave.
ZH: 加入我们吧。我们也在对抗英克雷。

EN: They will never torment us again with their experiments.
ZH: 他们再也不会用实验折磨我们了。

EN: What did they do with my poor friends?
ZH: 他们把我可怜的朋友们怎么了？

EN: Then you won't have scruples putting them down, will you? Their very existence is pain.
ZH: 那你送它们上路就不会有心理负担了，对吧？它们的存在本身即是痛苦。

EN: My poor babies... I'dd choose another fate if I could. Now I am buying their end.
ZH: 我可怜的孩子……要是我能选，我宁愿换一种命运。如今我愿出钱给它们买个解脱。

EN: Radroaches and Mole rats? Sorry friend, they were already monsters going in.
ZH: 辐射蟑螂和鼹鼠？抱歉朋友，它们进去之前就已经是怪物了。

EN: Let me guess, you want them put to rest? What's it worth to you?
ZH: 让我猜猜，你想让它们安息？那你打算出多少？

EN: They made me bring them Roaches and Mole rats. For what?
ZH: 他们逼我带蟑螂和鼹鼠来。干什么用？

EN: Only to torture them and turn them into fiends of war.
ZH: 只为了折磨它们，再把它们变成战争恶兽。

EN: And now they haunt the lower levels, a danger to all.
ZH: 如今它们游荡在底层，对所有人都是威胁。

EN: Hey you, get us out of here. We can pay.
ZH: 嘿，你们把我们弄出去，我们可以付钱。

EN: Here it is. Hey, hey, where are you going? GRIFTERS!
ZH: 就在这儿。嘿，嘿，你们去哪儿？骗子！

EN: THAT'S YOU! Soldiers, grab their gear. They'll get us free willingly or not.
ZH: 就是你们！士兵们，拿走他们的装备。他们自愿也好，不自愿也罢，都得放我们走。

EN: Here to gloat, then? Someday you'll be the one in a locked room. And I'll enjoy every moment.
ZH: 这是来幸灾乐祸的？总有一天会轮到你被关在锁死的房间里。到那时我会好好享受每一刻。

EN: Payment in advance.
ZH: 先付款。

EN: The Enclave remembers me already. We're winning the Gold War.
ZH: 英克雷已经记住我了。黄金之战我们正占上风。

EN: From what I hear, you deserve worse than this cell.
ZH: 据我所知，你们活该受比这牢房更惨的待遇。

EN: Those useless experiments think they run the place...
ZH: 那些没用的实验体以为这里归他们管……

EN: Free us, and the Enclave will remember.
ZH: 放了我们，英克雷会记住你们的。

EN: Careful, there are dangerous creatures around.
ZH: 小心点，附近有危险的生物。

EN: I am one of the "failed experiments", or so they claim. Thanks for the reminder.
ZH: 我就是那些“失败的实验体”之一，他们这么说的。多谢提醒。

EN: If you're so bold, save my brother and his... errr... companion.
ZH: 你若如此勇敢，去救我弟弟和他……呃……他的同伴吧。

EN: Thank you, stranger. If you find my brother, give him this. I can trust you, right?
ZH: 谢谢你，陌生人。你若找到我弟弟，把这个交给他。我可以信任你，对吧？

EN: Nevermind me, or them, what happened to you? You're blue.
ZH: 别管我，也别管它们。你怎么了？怎么浑身是蓝的？

EN: Monsters don't scare us, we scare them.
ZH: 怪物吓不倒我们，是我们吓它们。

EN: I'm a sucker for romance drama. I'm going in!
ZH: 我可是浪漫戏码的痴迷者。我要进去了！

EN: My twin and his true love are trapped below.
ZH: 我孪生兄弟和他的真爱被困在下面。

EN: Don't go after them only to meet your doom.
ZH: 别为了救他们，反倒把自己送上绝路。

EN: Prepare to be crushed by the might of Super Mole!
ZH: 准备好被超级鼹鼠的威力碾碎吧！

EN: Ah! A contender!
ZH: 啊！一个对手！

EN: Nice try! But you should have countered my insult, not ignore it. You lose.
ZH: 勇气可嘉！但你应该把我的侮辱骂回去，而不是无视它。你输了。

EN: That's not true. I'm... I'm <sob> very brave and... and... you win.
ZH: 那不是真的。我……我<哽咽>非常勇敢，而且……而且……你赢了。

EN: Hmm... I'd say neither of us scored a critical hit. A draw then.
ZH: 嗯……我觉得我们谁也没打出致命一击。那就平局吧。

EN: The loser gets eaten? You are so gross even Radroaches wouldn't touch you.
ZH: 输家要被吃掉？你恶心到连辐射蟑螂都不愿碰你。

EN: That's rich coming from a Deathclaw so weak and cowardly, you try to fight with words.
ZH: 这话出自一只又弱又懦、只敢动口不动手的死爪，可真够讽刺的。

EN: Why teach a Deathclaw to talk if what they say barely show sentience?
ZH: 死爪说的话几乎看不出有智慧，那教它说话又有什么意义？

EN: I challenge you, sir, to a battle of insults.
ZH: 我向你挑战，先生，来一场辱骂对决。

EN: The loser, of course, gets eaten!
ZH: 输家嘛，当然，要被吃掉！

EN: I'll start.
ZH: 我先来。

EN: You're so ugly, ghoulification would actually make you handsome.
ZH: 你丑得连尸鬼化都能让你变好看。

EN: Are you monsters? Rescuers? Either way, leave us be.
ZH: 你们是怪物？还是救援者？无论哪种，请别打扰我们。

EN: Alas, the cruely of the bigots ends in tragedy, yet our love will remain, eternal.
ZH: 唉，偏执者的残忍以悲剧收场，但我们的爱将永存，永恒不朽。

EN: Then we choose to stay here, in our cozy little nest.
ZH: 那我们选择留在这里，在我们温馨的小窝里。

EN: I miss him. Stay here, darling. I'll return soon.
ZH: 我想念他。留在这里，亲爱的。我很快就会回来。

EN: First, she is a he. And here, take this to prove you're wrong.
ZH: 首先，她其实是“他”。然后，拿着这个，好证明你是错的。

EN: This is the most unholy union I've every seen. I dread the spawn you'd create. I must end you.
ZH: 这是我所见过最不圣洁的结合。我恐惧你们会生出的后代。我必须终结你们。
